About.title: About
About.subtitle: A little more about me and how I work.
About.p1: I’m a software engineer who enjoys turning ambiguous problems into clear, fast and maintainable products. Most of my work lives in the TypeScript and React ecosystem, with a strong focus on the frontend platform: design systems, performance and accessibility.
About.p2: I care about the details that users never notice but always feel — predictable interactions, fast page loads, and interfaces that work for everyone. I like building systems that scale: clear architecture, good defaults, and code that the next person (often future me) can understand.
